claim: CFINet uses a Coarse-to-fine RPN + a Feature Imitation (FI) BRANCH with an auxiliary imitation loss for small object detection, integrated with Faster R-CNN.
support: Abstract and method section of the ICCV 2023 paper.

claim: CFINet achieves SOTA on SODA-D and SODA-A small object detection benchmarks when integrated with Faster R-CNN.
support: Reported in CFINet abstract and experiments section.

claim: QueryDet improves COCO mAP_small by 2.0 over its baseline and creates a new SOTA on VisDrone with a 2.3x high-resolution acceleration.
SAHI is an inference-time geometric slicing scheme that improves AP by +6.8 / +5.1 / +5.3 on FCOS / VFNet / TOOD; with fine-tuning the cumulative gain is +12.7 / +13.4 / +14.5.
Faster R-CNN with MGDFIS achieves 33.4% mAP on VisDrone (June 2025), +2% over the Faster R-CNN baseline and +12.5% AP50.
RemDet achieves SOTA on VisDrone with +3.4% mAP improvement at 110 FPS on a single RTX 4090.
CLAB adds a contrastive auxiliary branch at training that is dropped at inference, enhancing the video-object-detection backbone with no extra inference overhead.
Mr. DETR adds auxiliary training routes (Route-1 and Route-3) that perform one-to-many predictions and are discarded during inference; they do not affect model architecture or inference time.
RT-DETRv3 introduces multiple auxiliary branches during training that improve performance and accelerate convergence without adding inference latency.

OAN (Object-Aware Aggregation Network, Yang 2022 ECCV) does NOT exist as recalled. WebSearch on arxiv.org + openaccess.thecvf.com returned zero matches across two queries. The mechanism we attributed to OAN actually lives in CFINet (ev_0001) — Feature Imitation Branch + auxiliary imitation loss.
support: Falsification audit trail; preserved so the novelty-critic and any future maintainer can see the LLM-seed was caught.
